queries.sql:
select
      app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2($1,$2,$3,$4) as allowed,
      statement_timestamp()::text as evaluated_at, d.id::text as module_definition_id,
      d.entitlement_key from platform.module_definitions d
      where d.code=$4 and d.is_active and d.lifecycle_status in ('active','published')
        and d.valid_from<=statement_timestamp()
        and (d.valid_to is null or d.valid_to>statement_timestamp())

select * from (with allowed as materialized (select
      app_private.check_workspace_native_permission_v2($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::text,$4::text) as allowed),
    checked as materialized (select allowed,
      app_private.require_request_session_current_at_v1(clock_timestamp()) as session_guard from allowed)
    select txid_current()::text as database_transaction_id,auth.uid()::text as actor_id,
      current_setting('transaction_isolation') as isolation,
      to_char(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as evaluated_at,
      allowed,session_guard,(select revision::text from app_private.canonical_authority_revision_v1 where singleton) as authority_revision
    from checked) as final_observation

select agreement_id::text,tenant_id::text,workspace_id::text,provider_party_id::text,
    version,valid_from::text,valid_until::text,allowed_service_scope
    from platform.provider_agreement_versions_v1
    where agreement_id=$1::uuid and tenant_id=$2::uuid and workspace_id=$3::uuid and version=$4::integer for share

select d.id::text as definition_id,d.tenant_id::text as tenant_id,
    d.workspace_id::text as workspace_id,d.active as definition_current
  from service_catalog.definitions d
  where d.tenant_id=$1::uuid and d.workspace_id=$2::uuid and d.id=$3::uuid for key share of d

select id::text,tenant_id::text,archived_at is null and lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' as current
    from platform.customer_workspaces where id=$1::uuid and tenant_id=$2::uuid for share

select id::text,tenant_id::text,archived_at is null as current
    from portfolio.parties where id=$1::uuid and tenant_id=$2::uuid for share

select id::text,tenant_id::text,workspace_id::text,provider_party_id::text,
    current_version,revision,status from platform.provider_agreement_heads_v1
    where id=$1::uuid and tenant_id=$2::uuid and workspace_id=$3::uuid

select id::text,tenant_id::text,workspace_id::text,provider_party_id::text,
    current_version,revision,status from platform.provider_agreement_heads_v1
    where id=$1::uuid and tenant_id=$2::uuid and workspace_id=$3::uuid for share

select m.tenant_id::text, m.user_id::text as actor_id,
        m.status::text, (m.starts_at<=clock_timestamp()
          and (m.ends_at is null or m.ends_at>clock_timestamp())
          and g.starts_at<=clock_timestamp()
          and (g.ends_at is null or g.ends_at>clock_timestamp())) as current
      from identity.context_grants g join identity.memberships m
        on m.id=g.membership_id and m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id
      where g.id=$1

select o.tenant_id::text as tenant_id,o.workspace_id::text as workspace_id,
    o.id::text as offering_id,o.lock_version::text as offering_version,
    o.published_revision_id::text as published_revision_id,
    o.provider_party_id::text as provider_party_id,
    o.definition_id::text as definition_id
  from service_catalog.offerings o
  where o.tenant_id=$1::uuid and o.workspace_id=$2::uuid and o.id=$3::uuid
  for key share of o

select p.id::text as provider_party_id,p.tenant_id::text as tenant_id,
    p.archived_at is null as provider_current
  from portfolio.parties p where p.tenant_id=$1::uuid and p.id=$2::uuid for share of p

select r.tenant_id::text as tenant_id,r.workspace_id::text as workspace_id,
    r.offering_id::text as offering_id,r.id::text as published_revision_id,
    r.revision_version::text as published_revision_version,
    r.provider_agreement_id::text as provider_agreement_id,
    r.provider_agreement_version::text as provider_agreement_version,
    r.status::text as revision_status,
    to_char(r.valid_from at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as valid_from,
    case when r.valid_until is null then null else
      to_char(r.valid_until at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') end as valid_until,
    r.commercial_terms->>'acquisition_mode' as acquisition_mode,
    r.coverage,r.eligibility
  from service_catalog.revisions r
  where r.tenant_id=$1::uuid and r.workspace_id=$2::uuid
    and r.offering_id=$3::uuid and r.id=$4::uuid for share of r

select revision::text
      from app_private.canonical_authority_revision_v1 where singleton for share

select tenant_id::text
      from platform.customer_workspaces where id=$1 and archived_at is null
        and lifecycle_status='ACTIVE'

select txid_current()::text as database_transaction_id,
    auth.uid()::text as actor_id,
    to_char(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as evaluated_at

select txid_current()::text as database_transaction_id, auth.uid()::text as actor_id,
    current_setting('transaction_isolation') as isolation,
    to_char(clock_timestamp() at time zone 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as evaluated_at

select txid_current()::text as transaction_id,
        auth.uid()::text as actor_id, current_setting('transaction_isolation') as isolation,
        clock_timestamp()::text as evaluated_at
